questions.questionText: What would you do if you won the lottery tomorrow?
questions.expectedAnswer: If I won the lottery tomorrow, I would travel around the world and invest in my education.

questions.questionText: Is it essential to write down new vocabulary to remember it?
questions.expectedAnswer: Yes, it is essential or at least very helpful to write down new vocabulary to reinforce what we learn.

flashcards.definition: Absolutely necessary; extremely important in a particular situation.
flashcards.example: "High-speed repetition is essential for developing direct English reflexes."
